children: Silver steadied above $61 an ounce on Wednesday, halting a recent decline with falling oil prices offering some support despite continued pressure from elevated Treasury yields.

Oil prices dropped sharply amid signs of improving energy flows from the Middle East and following another major release of emergency reserves in the US. Meanwhile, precious metals remain under pressure from rising Treasury yields, with the 30-year US bond yield climbing as high as 5.62%, reaching levels not seen since June 2002.
Concerns over persistent energy-driven inflation, along with hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials, helped push yields higher.

New York Fed President John Williams said Tuesday that another rate increase “late this year” could be appropriate, while noting that the Middle East conflict and the expansion of artificial intelligence remain key drivers of elevated inflation.
Silver is on track to decline nearly 8% in September.

title: Silver Steadies on Lower Oil Prices
